name: SendGridEmail
description: Sends an email through SendGrid with optional file attachments (file picker, variables, and wildcard patterns supported).
helpMarkDown: Sends email using the SendGrid v3 API. Attachments can be selected with the file picker, provided via pipeline variables, or matched with wildcard patterns.
author: Phoenix DevOps

inputs.name: apiKey
inputs.label: SendGrid API Key
inputs.helpMarkDown: Your SendGrid API key. **Always use a secret variable**, e.g. `$(SendGridApiKey)`, defined in pipeline variables or a variable group with the lock icon enabled. Never paste the key in plain text.

inputs.name: fromAddress
inputs.label: From address
inputs.helpMarkDown: Sender email address. Must be a verified sender or authenticated domain in your SendGrid account.

inputs.name: fromName
inputs.label: From display name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional display name shown as the sender, e.g. `Build Pipeline`.

inputs.name: toAddresses
inputs.label: To
inputs.helpMarkDown: Recipient email address(es), separated by comma or semicolon.

inputs.name: ccAddresses
inputs.label: Cc
inputs.helpMarkDown: Cc address(es), separated by comma or semicolon.

inputs.name: bccAddresses
inputs.label: Bcc
inputs.helpMarkDown: Bcc address(es), separated by comma or semicolon.

inputs.name: subject
inputs.label: Subject
inputs.helpMarkDown: Email subject. Pipeline variables are supported, e.g. `Build $(Build.BuildNumber) finished`.

inputs.name: body
inputs.label: Body
inputs.helpMarkDown: Email body. Plain text by default; enable **Body is HTML** to send HTML.

inputs.name: bodyIsHtml
inputs.label: Body is HTML
inputs.helpMarkDown: If checked, the body is sent as `text/html`, otherwise as `text/plain`.

inputs.name: attachment
inputs.label: Attachment
inputs.helpMarkDown: A single file to attach. Use the picker (…) to browse the repository, or provide a variable-based path such as `$(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/report.pdf`.

inputs.name: additionalAttachments
inputs.label: Additional attachments (wildcards)
inputs.helpMarkDown: One pattern per line, relative to `$(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)` or absolute. Wildcards are supported, e.g. `drop/**/*.zip` or `$(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/logs/*.txt`.

inputs.name: failIfNoAttachmentsFound
inputs.label: Fail if attachment patterns match no files
inputs.helpMarkDown: If checked, the task fails when 'Additional attachments' patterns are provided but match no files. Uncheck to send the email anyway.

inputs.name: timeoutSeconds
inputs.label: Request timeout (seconds)
inputs.helpMarkDown: HTTP timeout for the SendGrid API call.
